title: Unacceptable Neglect and Discrimination Against Arabic Speakers on iOS
body:
To the Google Calendar Development Team,
I am writing to express my extreme frustration regarding the complete lack of Arabic language support in the Google Calendar iOS app. It is unacceptable to ignore a language spoken by hundreds of millions, especially when it is fully supported on your other platforms. This neglect feels discriminatory, dismissive, and shows a profound lack of respect for Arabic-speaking users. I demand an immediate update to fix this major flaw. I will be escalating this complaint and heavily criticizing this app publicly until our language is respected and fully integrated.
